jobs.full_reason: It computes only the PNUs whose inputs changed (root ADR-0180, ADR-0193), but the copy-on-write MERGE rewrites every data file holding one, and a national vintage's changes reach every file even in PNU range order (#896; computed).
jobs.full_cost: measured 2026-10-29 (journal and read-only Trino $snapshots): 2026-10-26 parcel_forest_ledger incremental, 48,477 PNUs changed, 892 s, wrote 1.855 GB (100%); 2026-10-23 parcel_transfer_history incremental, 52,780 PNUs, 6,249 s, wrote 3.256 GB (100%); 9.76 GB across the six kinds at 100% of bytes on each last commit. The shape-ledger check of 2026-10-29 12:36 still reports 100% bytes on every kind's last commit, and two kinds not ordered by PNU.
jobs.full_tracked_by: root ADR-0344 §6 (the merge-on-read MERGE and the delete fold are in, #959 and #960; the job becomes changed-keys once production measures a commit's bytes near the changed-key share)
jobs.description: Rebuild the Gold table of every by-PNU data kind line of config/r2-connections.contract.json (root ADR-0193 §9), one after the other, after the panel Gold rebuild: each kind is its host panel's section, built from the panel's own Silver pins and checked against the committed panel on every PNU before it writes (infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/by_pnu_kind_silver_to_gold.py). Started when the panel rebuild committed a panel, and at 09:15 as the fallback; a table it does not finish in its time is taken at its next run. A committed kind starts the by-PNU bake.

Reflect each new Gold snapshot of gold.parcel_panel, then gold.building_panel, then each pack-only lane's Gold panel this job carries the served edge of (config/r2-connections.contract.json by_pnu_lanes, root ADR-0190; a lane whose served edge another job carries bakes in that job, root ADR-0303, ADR-0333), in R2 by-PNU serving (root ADR-0096, ADR-0100, ADR-0141): a row_digest change set (by_pnu_panel_delta.py in the spark-small service, sequential with the export) decides between a create-only patch generation of the changed documents and tombstones, a manifest that only advances the reflected snapshot, and a full new base (forced with a reason, a document schema change, max_patches reached, or the cumulative change ratio exceeded). A patch is published only when its shards wrote exactly its change set; a base only when the shards' exported rows add up to the Gold row count. The lanes run one after the other in one unit: side by side they would not fit the host memory budget (root ADR-0138). Once a lane's manifest carries a section_packs block (root ADR-0147; the parcel lane too, ADR-0160), that lane bakes and publishes section packs instead: the change set goes from the packs' reflected snapshot, a patch writes each section's packs under the generation the lane serves it from, and a full bake is a new generation of every section. Started when a Gold rebuild committed a new snapshot, and at 10:15 as the fallback (root ADR-0171); a turn it defers (takes_turns) is taken at the next start, and each lane is an asset of the asset reconciler (asset_reconcile), which starts the job when a lane's Gold moved past what it serves or its last run failed.

assets.title: 필지 용도지역 판정 by-PNU 표
assets.description: PNU마다 포함코드 1·2 의 용도지역과 코드표 앵커만 담는 데이터 종류 표(루트 ADR-0193). 계약의 종류 한 줄(parcel-zoning)에서 유도되고, 필지 패널의 같은 섹션 함수로 만든다.

assets.title: 건물 by-PNU 서빙 문서
assets.description: gold.building_panel 스냅숏을 PNU당 1객체 JSON으로 세대 디렉터리에 굽는다(루트 ADR-0100). manifest 발행은 별도 명령이며 운영 발행량은 실행 증거로 판단한다.

assets.title: 건물 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.building_panel 의 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음 파일(머리+색인+본문, 문서 통째의 gzip 덩어리)로 굽는다(루트 ADR-0147, ADR-0151). 2026-10-07 부터 운영 주소가 이 묶음으로 서빙하고, 매일 바뀐 문서는 패치 묶음으로 반영한다.

assets.title: 필지 by-PNU 서빙 문서
assets.description: gold.parcel_panel 스냅숏을 PNU당 1객체 JSON으로 세대 디렉터리에 굽는다(루트 ADR-0096). manifest 발행은 별도 명령이며 운영 발행량은 실행 증거로 판단한다.

assets.title: 필지 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.parcel_panel 의 PNU 문서(용도지역·공시지가·토지특성·임야대장·토지이동이력·대지권을 합친 한 문서)를 법정동 묶음 파일로 굽는다(루트 ADR-0147 §8, ADR-0160). 건물 묶음과 같은 형식·관문·Worker 소스를 쓴다. 전환 전에는 객체가 서빙한다.

assets.title: 필지 용도지역 판정 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.parcel_zoning 의 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음으로만 굽는다. 필지 호스트의 Worker 가 /parcels/zoning/by-pnu/ 경로로 서빙한다(루트 ADR-0193). 첫 발행은 운영자의 묶음 전용 관문을 거친다.
